items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: He wanted me to do like Willie the Lion.

ctx.x: I had one booking agent tell me once in New York, the late Billy Show, when I first went there he said, Sir Charles, you've got to have gimmicks. Always carry a brief case in your hand and have a big cigar and wear a derby. He wanted me to do like Willie the Lion. I didn't think that was too original, so I thought I would stick with my music.
